title: Tooltip configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.TooltipAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsHover.description: Opens on hover/focus; when false it opens on click.

Position.description: Placement of the balloon relative to the trigger (GlobalEnum.Position).

StartVisible.description: Shows the tooltip as soon as it is built.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
